eras.source: Delaware General Assembly (SB 199, finalized by HB 335)
eras.note: Same enactment path as the House map. Unchallenged in court. Terms are tied to the redistricting cycle rather than a clean half-every-cycle split — roughly 10-11 of 21 seats are up each 2-year cycle, with a one-time 2-year term for part of the chamber right after redistricting. Veto override is 3/5, not 2/3.

redistricting.text: Kept 64% of its population from the 2016–2020 SD-1; gained the rest from the old SD-5 (21%), the old SD-2 (8%), the old SD-4 (4%) and 1 more. Entirely in New Castle County. 2020 presidential margin D+50.1 on the 2016–2020 lines → D+48.4 on the current lines.
